perplexity.description:
The Utopia Strong is the self-titled debut album by the British electronic rock trio The Utopia Strong, released in 2019 on Rocket Recordings. The group, formed in Glastonbury and consisting of Steve Davis, Kavus Torabi, and Michael J. York, blends experimental electronic textures with psychedelic rock and progressive elements. The album features a distinctive fusion of modular synthesizers, hypnotic rhythms, and atmospheric soundscapes, drawing from the members’ backgrounds in both electronic and avant-garde music. Guest vocals by Katharine Blake of Mediæval Bæbes add an ethereal quality to select tracks, further enhancing the album’s otherworldly atmosphere.

As the first full-length release in their discography, The Utopia Strong established the band’s signature cosmic and improvisational style, setting the stage for their subsequent albums International Treasure (2022) and Doperider (2025). The album was well-received for its innovative approach, with critics noting its immersive sound and genre-defying character. It marked a significant departure from the members’ previous work, showcasing their collective interest in psychedelic and electronic experimentation. The debut’s success helped position The Utopia Strong as a notable act within the UK’s experimental music scene.
